english.title: Master / person directed to undertake tasks fail to comply with regulation on operation of ship’s steering gear
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) were the

(A)_[master]_
(B)_[person directed to undertake a task in respect of the operation of steering gear]_

of a ship, namely **(..SPECIFY NAME OF SHIP..), which did not comply with regulation 25 of Chapter V in the Annex to the International Convention for the Safety of Life at Sea 1974 in that **(..SPECIFY NON-COMPLIANCE..)
english.legislation: Contrary to regulations 5(2)(k) and 9(3) and (5) of the Merchant Shipping (Safety of Navigation) Regulations 2020.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location
master / person directed to undertake a task in respect of the operation of steering gear
on a ship
failed to comply with regulation 25 of Chapter V in the Annex
to the International Convention for the Safety of Life at Sea 1974

other.penalty:
Summary: A fine.
Indictment: Two years imprisonment and / or a fine.

Time limit for prosecutions:
None

On the 12th March 2015 the limit on fines imposed by a Magistrates' court was removed – as such, the potential fine on summary conviction in relation to an offence committed after this date is unlimited.
